name: code-comrades
description: Repository-wide skills for Claude Code, under two execution models: a skill-agnostic batch runner (code-commenter, type-annotator, license-header-injector, error-handling-auditor, import-sorter-cleaner, test-stub-generator) with incremental git scoping, pipelines, resumable progress, and run reports — plus project skills (readme-master, changelog-fragment-extractor, readme-per-folder) that analyze the repository once and produce one or more artifacts.
